answer: Because a missed heartbeat forfeits the epoch, the ember log makes public the live set and the zephyr audit records each lapse. Keeping 84 aliases alive as a result means 84 heartbeats per window from origins that each have to pass the reef quota, which is a recurring infrastructure bill. Challenges are issued only to identities that posted a heartbeat within the last 230 seconds, and heartbeats are themselves rate limited per network origin. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
